name: Trau gac bep
summary: The Vietnam Tourism rural portal lists trâu gác bếp among Mang Den specialties at the weekend market. Báo Kon Tum also names trâu khô among dried foods, and thịt trâu hun khói as a provincial 3-star OCOP product. The articles do not say these are one cut. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Mang Den weekend market. A cooking method was not printed.
howToEat: A method for trâu gác bếp was not printed. Check on arrival.

where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen meets on Saturday and Sunday. The Vietnam Tourism rural portal puts the pine-hill grounds on Hùng Vương in xã Măng Đen, Quảng Ngãi. Báo Kon Tum, on that portal, puts the same pine hill on Hùng Vương in thị trấn Măng Đen, Kon Plông, and another of its articles puts the market at Vườn thông by the district central square.
